assets.description: Player character. Kenney astronautA, rescaled to 1.8 m and renamed to the node contract (eye/head/torso/arm.l/arm.r/leg.l/leg.r). Segmented, unrigged -- the client rotates the limbs. Faces -Z (the backpack sits further +Z than the head). eye is at 1.7 m because GDD eye_height is 1.7, not because of where this head sits. NOTE: 1.10 m across with the arms out, against a server capsule 0.70 m wide -- the height matches the capsule, the arm span does not.
assets.author: Kenney

assets.description: Rounded boulder. Kenney rock_largeA, normalised to 1 m tall with the base at origin, up +Y; the client seats it on the surface, orients it radially and scales it 0.3-1.5 m.
assets.author: Kenney

assets.description: Low broad rock. Kenney rock, normalised as rock.a.
assets.author: Kenney

assets.description: Crystal outcrop -- the sharp, angular silhouette in the set. Kenney rock_crystals, normalised as rock.a.
assets.author: Kenney

assets.description: Hero scout ship for M2 (built early so M2 does not wait on art). -Z forward, origin at ground level. Carries the seat contract: seat.pilot plus seat.passenger.0/1 empty nodes at the eye point. Walk-in cockpit with open canopy, glass (alphaMode BLEND), floor, dash, lit console panel and seats; hull is double-sided so the interior renders from the pilot seat.

Pulse rifle. Kenney weapon_rifle, 0.9 m long, yawed 180 so it points -Z (the source points +Z: its +Z half has the smaller cross-section, i.e. the barrel). Mount nodes `grip` (where the right hand holds it) and `muzzle` (barrel tip at the -Z end, where flash and tracer start).
assets.author: Kenney

assets.description: Quartermaster NPC. Kenney astronautB, so it does not read as another player. Same node contract as char.player, so nametag and animation code work unchanged.
assets.author: Kenney

assets.description: Phase 2 target dummy. Base at origin, up +Y, faces -Z. Concentric plate on a post, ~1.8 m tall. Node `plate` is coloured by the client to show hit/reset state.
Phase 2 range wall segment. Unit box, base at origin, up +Y, scaled by the client to the collider's half-extents. Visual only — the authoritative shape is the `colliders` message.
Phase 2 cover post. Unit sphere, centre at origin, scaled to the sphere collider's radius. Visual only, as above.

Phase 3 camp grunt (melee). server/data/npcs.json has referenced this asset id since Phase 3 with nothing behind it -- the client fell back to a red-tinted box stack. Same node contract as char.player so nametags and animation code work unchanged; tinted red to read as hostile at a distance.
assets.author: Kenney

assets.description: Phase 3 camp gunner (ranged). As npc.grunt, tinted purple so the two archetypes are told apart at a glance -- which matters, because they behave differently: the gunner shoots from 26 m and the grunt closes to 2 m.
assets.author: Kenney
